method.background_point: Each cutoff also exceeds the largest value seen on the four isolated selection backgrounds.
method.context: Largest original three-second logit that fully contains the short interval, or no support.
method.context_score: Minimum strict empirical rank of short response and containing coarse response.
method.evaluation: A useful interval covers half a known edit with temporal IoU at least .30. Genuine time is deduplicated.
method.group_point: Per-width point based on the second-highest ordinary selection speaker maximum.
method.nonmaximum_suppression: Suppress intervals overlapping at least half of a selected interval.
